title: The model price table is valid for at least 7 more days, so logo and menu photo reading are not silently skipped
steps: S1: Read validUntil in apps/tracy-web/src/opportunities-build/quality-prices.json and compare it with the current date.
expect: S1: validUntil is more than 7 days ahead; otherwise the test fails and names the file to renew.
evidence: Since 2026-10-27 the table was expired: QUALITY_PRICE_UNKNOWN, vision door not_tested on every research run
fence: Checks the committed table against the clock; it does not call the provider or check the prices are still current
